people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

translations.web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
translations.bsb: As Jesus drew near to Jericho, a blind man was sitting beside the road, begging.
